suitableFor: listing/landing page intro banners with a feature photo and a short heading + description
content-width feature image with a white text panel overlapping its lower edge
section intros that need an image plus a brief lead-in but no call-to-action
notSuitableFor: promo banners that need a CTA button (use hero-banner)
image-only editorial article leads with the title rendered below as default content (use hero-article)

distinctFrom.hero: Vanilla local 'hero' is bare boilerplate (background-image + overlaid heading, toggles a no-image class only). hero-listing renders a content-width feature image with a separate white heading+description panel overlapping the image's lower edge.
distinctFrom.hero-banner: hero-banner (colorScheme=accent) always renders a CTA button and is full-bleed with a 2:1 letterbox crop or a grey side panel. hero-listing has NO CTA and keeps the image at content width with a white overlay panel. Similarity scored ~0.75 (< 0.80 threshold).
distinctFrom.hero-article: hero-article is image-ONLY (no in-block heading/description; the article title renders below as default content). hero-listing renders the heading and description inside the block over the image. Structural mismatch — new variant created.
